name: dsh-tts-monorepo
description: DSH audio packages: a reliable TTS engine (@leiboss/dsh-tts) and a long-form voiceover pipeline (@leiboss/dsh-voiceover).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @leiboss/dsh-tts && npm run build -w @leiboss/dsh-voiceover
scripts.test: npm run test -w @leiboss/dsh-tts && npm run test -w @leiboss/dsh-voiceover
